points.problem: Complete software Video7 overlay/body update before capture
points.evidence: Original gfx_updt.c vga_graph_update draws Video7 pointer after a full body paint but after a partial paint only when v7ptr_between_lines is true. Original draw_v7ptr reads controller enable/coordinates/pattern and calls selected host callback. Current software compositor stores old background;begin_update clears the overlay before body writes so later clear cannot restore stale pre-paint pixels. A partial body update outside pointer then leaves it absent unless end_update redraws it. capture refuses update_depth>0;end_update decrements and signals dirty only at matching outer end. Restoring empty original end leaves depth held and pointer absent. Removing only unconditional begin clear instead allows subsequent paint to restore old background over freshly painted pixels. These are source state-order counterexamples,not a newly reproduced guest mouse failure.
